channel.title: AdvisoryOps — Actively Exploited Medical Device Vulnerabilities

item.title: CVE-2008-0015

A patch is not available for this issue, so it's crucial to limit exposure by disabling the affected ActiveX control if it is not essential for operations. Further steps should be taken to monitor and protect affected systems from potential attacks.
